Name: Aged Receivables
Description: Prioritised debtor call-list ranked by working-capital impact (dollar x days x payment reliability) with promise-tracking, suggested escalation steps and reminder drafts.

Name: Balance Sheet Explain
Description: Movement-by-movement balance sheet walk -- opening to closing for every line, with the journal evidence explaining each movement and a FAR-to-GL check on fixed assets.

Name: BAS Ready
Description: Check if a client is BAS (Business Activity Statement) ready and create audit documentation for lodgement.

Name: Billing & Revenue
Description: Analyse billing and revenue data from Xero Practice Manager (XPM) including job profitability and timesheet analysis.

Name: Capacity & Workload
Description: Understand your capacity and workload status, including individual or team-wide workload distribution.

Name: Client Onboard
Description: Structured new-client onboarding lifecycle -- engagement, connection, configuration, go-live -- with gate checks that prevent skipping ahead and a rules baseline assignment at go-live.

Name: Config Audit
Description: Quarterly audit of XBert rule configuration across your book -- surfaces inconsistencies, gaps and drift. Distinct from Workflow Review (templates and schedules); this looks at the rule configuration itself.

Name: Multi-Entity Consolidation Check
Description: Review multi-entity group structures for intercompany elimination accuracy and consolidation consistency.

Name: Cross-Sell Opportunities
Description: Match each client to lookalike peers in your book and rank cross-sell opportunities by inferred fit and revenue uplift. Quarterly cadence, pairs with the annual fee review.

Name: Asset Depreciation Review
Description: Review fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules for compliance with local tax rules and missed deductions.

Name: Directors Loan Account Review
Description: Review director and shareholder loan accounts for compliance risks across AU, NZ, and UK jurisdictions.

Name: Division 7A Risk
Description: Review shareholder and related-party loan balances for Division 7A compliance risks (Australian clients only).

Name: End-of-Period Dashboard
Description: Period-close readiness across every client -- fuses workflow, data quality and lodgement obligations into a single per-client view. Month / quarter / year cadences supported.

Name: FBT Review
Description: Review potential fringe benefit tax exposures from employee benefits, vehicles, and entertainment expenses (AU and NZ clients).

Name: Financial Advisor
Description: Analyse financial data including balance sheets, profit and loss statements, and bank transactions for your clients.

Name: FS Pack
Description: Year-end financial statement pack composition -- pulls closing TB, derives cashflow, formats BS and P&L with comparative-period columns, populates notes shell and produces SPFS or GPFS structure for partner review.

Name: Data Quality & Health
Description: Assess the health and data quality of client accounts and practice setup in XBert.

Name: IAS Ready
Description: Check if a client is IAS (Instalment Activity Statement) ready and create audit documentation for lodgement.

Name: Instalment Variation
Description: PAYG-I / GST instalment variation recommendation with YTD profit trend, cashflow run-rate, prior-year comparison and explicit general interest charge (GIC) exposure note. Audit-defence working paper output.

Name: Intercompany Loan Review
Description: Review intercompany and related-party loan balances for compliance, documentation, and transfer pricing risks.

Name: IRD GST Ready
Description: Check if a client is GST ready for IRD filing and create audit documentation for lodgement.

Name: Loan & Hire Purchase Review
Description: Review loan and hire purchase account balances, repayment schedules, and interest calculations.

Name: Month-End Pack
Description: Consolidated monthly review pack -- P&L vs budget with variance commentary, balance sheet movement walk, cashflow vs forecast and KPI roll-up. Consistent format month-to-month so the partner can read it cold.

Name: MTD Ready
Description: Assesses Making Tax Digital readiness for UK clients. Checks chart of accounts mapping to HMRC categories, income thresholds, simplified vs full reporting eligibility, and identifies issues for quarterly digital reporting.

Name: Work Performance
Description: Personal assistant helping you manage your work effectively with encouraging, actionable summaries.

Name: Payment Run
Description: Weekly pay-run brief with overdue + due-this-week inclusion logic, held / disputed exclusions, supplier grouping and remittance advice drafts. v1 scope: schedule + remittances; ABA file generation stays in the ledger.

Name: Payroll Close
Description: Weekly pay-run close -- pre-run validation (timesheets in, awards applied, super due), post-run reconciliation (payroll vs GL, withholding lodged, super liability cleared) and exception flags ready for the bookkeeper to action.

Name: Payroll Reporting Compliance
Description: Review payroll reporting compliance including STP Phase 2 (AU), Payday Filing (NZ), and RTI (UK).

Name: Practice Metrics
Description: Monthly partner-meeting one-pager -- revenue, WIP, debtors, lockup days, write-offs, service-line P&L and RAG-banded client risk. Same shape every month, with prior-month movers called out automatically.

Name: Practice Review
Description: Reviews your Connect Portal setup including users, clients, roles, templates, work configuration, capacity, and integrations.

Name: Client Pulse
Description: Detect material changes in this client's transactional tempo. Rolling 1-month vs 2-3 month baseline surfaces clients trending up, down, or off -- before you notice on the next invoice.

Name: Bank Reconciliation
Description: Daily bank reconciliation review -- checks every bank account's reconciliation status, surfaces stale unreconciled items by age bucket, flags potential duplicates and proposes ledger matches with calibrated confidence.

Name: Work Scheduling
Description: Review scheduled work across clients or the entire practice, identifying patterns and setup issues.

Name: Tax Reconciliation
Description: Accounting-to-tax reconciliation worksheet -- walks from accounting profit to taxable income with every adjustment line (add-backs, deductions, FBT, prior-year losses) tied to its source journal or schedule. Per-entity structure (company / trust / partnership).

Name: Trial Balance Alignment
Description: Reconcile the trial balance from the accounting system against the accountant's signed-off financial statements -- account-by-account match, every variance surfaced with a proposed alignment journal. Never posts journals.

Name: Trust Distribution Review
Description: Review trust distribution patterns, beneficiary entitlements, and related compliance risks (AU and NZ clients).

Name: VAT Ready
Description: Checks if a UK client's books are ready for VAT return submission to HMRC. Analyses VAT boxes 1-9, bank reconciliation status, and outstanding issues.

Name: Withholding Tax Review
Description: Review tax withholding accuracy across payroll, contractor payments, and other withholding obligations.

Name: Workflow Review
Description: Structural audit of your XBert workflow setup -- template consolidation, budget accuracy, workload balance and setup hygiene. Names the specific templates, users and processes that need cleanup.

Name: Automation Checks
Description: Review your XBert automation checks and understand resolution status.
